"executive_summary": "GUIDEMOL is a Python-based graphical user interface (GUI) designed to simplify the calculation of molecular descriptors and 3D grid representations for chemoinformatics users lacking programming skills. Built upon the RDKit library and utilizing the tkinter package, the software allows users to compute a wide array of descriptors, including RDF, MORSE, WHIM, and others, directly from input files. Beyond standard descriptors, GUIDEMOL uniquely facilitates the generation of 3D molecular grids encoding electrostatic potentials or voxelized atomic properties, which are critical for deep learning applications in structure-based drug design. The application features a user-friendly interface with various widgets for parameter selection, such as atomic charge models (Gasteiger or MMFF) and grid dimensions. It also provides a robust command-line interface (CLI) for batch processing and scriptable workflows, ensuring flexibility for both novice and expert users. The source code is openly available under a BSD license, promoting transparency and extensibility for the scientific community. judge_context:
Executive Summary
GUIDEMOL is a Python-based graphical user interface (GUI) designed to simplify the calculation of molecular descriptors and 3D grid representations for chemoinformatics users lacking programming expertise. Built upon the RDKit library and utilizing the tkinter package, the software allows users to compute standard RDKit descriptors (such as RDF, WHIM, and GETAWAY) and generate 3D grids encoding electrostatic potentials or atomic voxels. The application features a user-friendly interface with various widgets for parameter selection, including options for charge calculation methods (Gasteiger or MMFF) and grid dimensions. Beyond the GUI, a command-line interface (CLI) is provided for batch processing and advanced parameter specification. The source code is open-source under the BSD license, facilitating extension and adaptation for other chemoinformatics tasks. The tool addresses the need for accessible software in educational and research settings where complex molecular modeling is required but coding skills are absent.

Research Context
Molecular descriptors are central to QSPR/QSAR methodology. Chemoinformatics is permeating curricula, requiring teaching software. Existing tools include CDK, OCHEM, and proprietary software. RDKit is widely used in machine learning projects. Python enables easy development of GUIs using tkinter. 3D grid representations are gaining attention for AI processing.

Research Question And Hypothesis
The study aims to create a minimalist interface for routine tasks. The hypothesis is that a GUI removes the need for programming skills. The tool should support both 2D descriptors and 3D grid representations. Users should be able to specify parameters like charge types and grid sizes. The software should be extensible for other descriptors or tasks.

Methodological Details
The study developed a Python program based on RDKit. The interface uses the tkinter package for the GUI. The source code is available at a specific GitHub repository. The license is the three-clause Berkeley Software Distribution (BSD) license. A log file is created to register processing success or failure. The interface uses native look-and-feel dialog windows for file selection. Users can choose input and output files via the interface. The software calculates descriptors implemented in RDKit. The software calculates grid representations using electrostatic potential or voxels. A CLI is also provided for the calculation of grid representations.

Procedures And Architectures
The interface was built with various types of tkinter widgets. The grid geometry manager controls the layout of the widgets. Buttons trigger calculations for 3D structures or descriptors. Checkbuttons enable YES/NO options for specific descriptors. Radiobuttons enable choices among mutually exclusive options. Entries allow users to submit numbers like coordinates. Labels display text before Entry areas. 3D structures are obtained with the RDKit function MMFFOptimizeMolecule. The MMFF94 variant is used with a maximum of 5000 iterations. Options include removing metals or keeping the largest fragment. Hydrogen atoms are added with Chem.AddHs(). Descriptors are selected from the RDKit rdMolDescriptors module. Available descriptors include RDF, MORSE, WHIM, AUTOCORR3D, GETAWAY, PEOE_VSA and SMR_VSA. Electrostatic potential grids use Gasteiger or MMFF partial atomic charges. The EP at each cube is calculated using a specific summation formula. Voxelisation uses a Gaussian function based on atomic properties. Implemented properties include atomic number, partial charge, and refractivity. Missing hydrogens can be added with addCoords=True. The molecular descriptors are saved in a csv output file. The CLI command specifies input file, output file, grid type, and atomic property. The CLI allows specification of grid center coordinates and cube size. An example command calculates an EP grid with Gasteiger charges.

Key Results
The software successfully calculates descriptors implemented in RDKit. The software generates grid representations using electrostatic potential or voxels. The interface provides easy access for users with no programming skills. The application can be adapted to calculate other descriptors. A CLI is provided for the calculation of grid representations. The source code is available at https://github.com/jairesdesousa/guidemol. The software uses the MMFF94 variant for 3D structure generation. The software supports Gasteiger or MMFF partial atomic charges. The software calculates voxelisation based on atomic properties. The molecular descriptors are saved in a csv output file. The CLI command allows specification of grid center coordinates. The CLI command allows specification of the atomic property. The CLI command allows specification of the grid size in each direction. The software was developed as a minimalist interface to routine tasks. The software is released with a BSD license.

Interpretation And Theoretical Implications
The GUI facilitates access to descriptors by scientists or students. The tool requires no programming skills to use. The 3D grid representations can be obtained via the CLI. Possible bugs or limitations can be easily detected and fixed. The software serves as a template for GUIs to other chemoinformatics tasks. The tool integrates well-established descriptors with 3D grid capabilities. The software bridges the gap between complex RDKit tools and non-programmers. The open-source nature promotes community contribution and improvement.

Contradictions And Limitations
The paper notes that different values were obtained with the same RDKit version in different runs. An example of inconsistency was found with the 3D structure generated for COc1ccc(cc1(OC))Br. The paper does not mention any known bugs or limitations other than the reproducibility issue.

Claims
GUIDEMOL provides a user-friendly interface for calculating molecular descriptors and 3D grids. The application facilitates the access to descriptors by scientists or students. The tool requires no programming skills to use. The software was developed as a minimalist interface to routine tasks.  The software serves as a template for GUIs to other chemoinformatics tasks.
The software integrates RDKit tools with a graphical interface and command-line options. GUIDEMOL is a Python computer program based on the RDKit software. A CLI is also provided for the calculation of grid representations.  The source code is released with a BSD license.
3D grid representations can be generated using electrostatic potential or voxels. as well as grid representations of 3D molecular structures using the electrostatic potential or voxels. The grid of electrostatic potential is generated by the Gasteiger or MMFF partial atomic charges.  The 3D grid representations can also be obtained via the CLI.

Data And Code Availability
The source code is available at https://github.com/jairesdesousa/guidemol. The software is released with a BSD license. The software allows both commercial and non-commercial use.

Robustness And Ablation Notes
It was observed that for some molecules, and some GETAWAY, MORSE and WHIM descriptors, different values were obtained with the same RDKit version (2022.9.5) in different runs or in different operating systems. An example was with the 3D structure generated for COc1ccc(cc1(OC))Br.

Ethical Considerations
The software is released with a BSD license. The software allows both commercial and non-commercial use.

Three Takeaways
1. The core contribution is a Python GUI for RDKit-based molecular descriptors and 3D grids. 2. The strongest evidence is the successful implementation of various descriptors and grid types. 3. The future path involves easy extension for other descriptors or tasks.
